properties.name: isProvisional
properties.description: Whether this is a provisional page target.

properties.name: isPaused
properties.description: Whether the target is paused on start and has to be explicitely resumed by inspector.

types.description: State of a debugger pause session. While it is paused, the UI process holds every page of the browsing context group: each frame is either stopped or held. Closed means the hold was released, not that no frame is stopped: a frame can stay in the debugger, so Debugger.paused and Debugger.resumed remain the source of truth for which frames are stopped.

commands.name: setPauseOnStart
commands.description: If set to true, new targets will be paused on start waiting for resume command. Other commands can be dispatched on the target before it is resumed.

parameters.name: pauseOnStart
parameters.description: If set to true, new targets will be paused on start waiting for resume command.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Will resume target if it was paused on start.

commands.name: sendMessageToTarget
commands.description: Send an Inspector Protocol message to be dispatched to a Target's agents.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: JSON Inspector Protocol message (command) to be dispatched on the backend.

events.name: didCommitProvisionalTarget
events.description: This event is fired when provisional load is committed. Provisional target swaps with the current target.

parameters.name: oldTargetId
parameters.description: ID of the old target that is swapped with the committed one.

events.name: debuggerPauseSessionChanged
events.description: Fired when a debugger pause session opens, when the set of frames whose pause has not ended changes, and when the hold is released.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Identifies the session from the event that opens it to the event that closes it.

parameters.name: stoppingTargetIds
parameters.description: Targets of the frames whose pause has not ended yet. A frame that has resumed stays listed until its process is idle, which can be after Debugger.resumed. Empty when the session is closed, even if a frame is still stopped.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: JSON Inspector Protocol message (response or event) to be dispatched on the frontend.
